props.name: autoRowHeight
props.description: Measures each rendered row instead of trusting `rowHeight`, so rows grow with their content (wrapping cells, custom renderers). `rowHeight` stays the estimate for rows that have not been rendered yet. Requires virtualization.

props.name: cellNavigation
props.description: APG grid keyboard navigation — `role="grid"`, a roving-tabindex active cell, and arrow-key movement across header and data cells.

props.name: cellSelection
props.description: Spreadsheet-style cell ranges — shift-click, drag and shift+arrows, with Ctrl/Cmd+C copying the range as TSV and Ctrl/Cmd+A selecting everything. Implies `cellNavigation`.

props.name: columnFilters
props.description: Renders a filter row in the header with an input per filterable column.

props.name: columnMenu
props.description: Adds a per-column header menu — `true` builds it from the enabled features (sort/pin/move/hide); a builder `({ column, defaultActions }) => actions` returns the final item list.

props.name: columnMenuIcon
props.description: Custom column menu button icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: columnOrder
props.description: Enables drag-and-drop column reordering; an array sets the initial order.

props.name: columnPinning
props.description: Freezes columns (by `key`) to the start/end edge with sticky positioning; `true` enables the feature with no initial pins.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions.

props.name: columnSizing
props.description: Enables column resize handles; `mode` controls whether widths update while dragging (`'onChange'`, the default) or on release (`'onEnd'`).

props.name: columnVisibility
props.description: Enables hiding/showing columns via `column.toggleVisibility()`; an object sets the initial visibility.

props.name: dataProvider
props.description: Server-side mode: the grid requests data on every sorting/filter/page change; implies pagination.

props.name: editing
props.description: Inline cell editing on Enter/F2/double-click for columns opting in via `editable`/`editor`; implies `cellNavigation`.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content (ReactNode) shown when no rows match.

props.name: features
props.description: The registered TanStack feature set — pass `dataGridLiteFeatures` (or a custom `tableFeatures({...})` set) so the app bundle only carries the features it uses; defaults to the full `dataGridFeatures`.

props.name: filterIcon
props.description: Icon for the per-column filter button.

props.name: globalFilter
props.description: Renders a search input above the grid that filters across all columns.

props.name: hideColumnIcon
props.description: Custom hide-column menu action icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: history
props.description: Undo/redo history of edit commits — Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z/Ctrl+Y plus toolbar buttons; requires `editing`.

props.name: infiniteScroll
props.description: Appends each loaded page to the rows already in view instead of replacing them; requires `dataProvider` and `virtualization`, cannot be combined with `pagination`.

props.name: itemKey
props.description: Stable row id — required for selection to survive sorting and filtering.

props.name: items
props.description: Row data.

props.name: labels
props.description: UI strings (i18n), merged over the defaults; supports `{token}` interpolation.

props.name: moveEndIcon
props.description: Custom move-right menu action icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: moveStartIcon
props.description: Custom move-left menu action icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: onCellCopy
props.description: Fires after Ctrl/Cmd+C copies a cell selection, with the text written to the clipboard.

props.name: onDataError
props.description: Fires when the data provider rejects, with the error (server-side mode).

props.name: onDataLoad
props.description: Fires when the data provider resolves, with the `{ items, totalRows }` response (server-side mode).

props.name: onEditCancel
props.description: Fires when an edit is cancelled, with the item and column key.

props.name: onEditCommit
props.description: Fires when an edit commits, with `{ item, columnId, value, previousValue }` — the grid never mutates `items`; apply the change and re-render.

props.name: onEditStart
props.description: Fires when a cell enters edit mode, with the item and column key.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Fires when column filters or the global filter change, with both filter states.

props.name: onOrderChange
props.description: Fires when columns are reordered, with the TanStack columnOrder state.

props.name: onPaginationChange
props.description: Fires when the page or page size changes, with the TanStack pagination state.

props.name: onPinningChange
props.description: Fires when column pinning changes, with the TanStack columnPinning state.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Fires when the row selection changes, with the TanStack rowSelection state and the selected items.

props.name: onSortingChange
props.description: Fires when sorting changes, with the TanStack sorting state.

props.name: onVisibilityChange
props.description: Fires when column visibility changes, with the TanStack columnVisibility state.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Extra rows rendered above and below the visible window.

props.name: pagination
props.description: Pagination mode — mutually exclusive with virtualization.

props.name: pinEndIcon
props.description: Custom pin-right menu action icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: pinStartIcon
props.description: Custom pin-left menu action icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: printTitle
props.description: Heading printed above the table when the print action runs; omitted when unset.

props.name: rowHandleIcon
props.description: Custom row drag-handle icon (ReactNode) replacing the default grip.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Estimated row height in px used by the virtualizer.

props.name: rowOrder
props.description: Adds a drag handle per row for reordering; the grid emits `onRowOrderChange` with the reordered array instead of mutating `items`.

props.name: rowSelection
props.description: Checkbox selection with select-all and shift+click ranges.

props.name: slots
props.description: Replaces built-in chrome — each slot is a component rendered with `{ table, labels }`.

props.name: sortAscendingIcon
props.description: Custom ascending sort indicator icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: sortDescendingIcon
props.description: Custom descending sort indicator icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: sorterVisibility
props.description: Controls when the neutral (unsorted) sort icon is shown on sortable columns: `'always'` keeps it visible, `'hover'` reveals it on header hover/focus. Omit to hide it until the column is sorted.

props.name: sorting
props.description: Column sorting; shift+click adds columns to the sort.

props.name: sortNeutralIcon
props.description: Custom unsorted sort indicator icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: stateKey
props.description: Persists the grid state (sorting, filters, order, sizing, visibility, pinning, selection, page) to localStorage under this key — autosaved on every change and restored on mount.

props.name: tableRef
props.description: Ref that receives the TanStack table instance.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Adds a built-in toolbar above the grid — `true` enables every action whose feature is on (column chooser, CSV export, global search); an object picks each individually.

props.name: toolbarColumnsIcon
props.description: Custom toolbar column-chooser button icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: toolbarExportIcon
props.description: Custom toolbar export button icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: toolbarPrintIcon
props.description: Icon for the toolbar's print button.

props.name: toolbarRedoIcon
props.description: Custom toolbar redo button icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: toolbarUndoIcon
props.description: Custom toolbar undo button icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: unpinIcon
props.description: Custom unpin menu action icon (ReactNode) replacing the default one.

props.name: virtualization
props.description: Windowed rendering for large datasets.
